about.supportText: MinorIDE is free and open source, made by one person in spare time. A small contribution helps keep it fast, native and growing. Thank you!
about.thanksDevelopers: To developers: pull requests from your fork are welcome.
about.thanksProjects: To the open source projects MinorIDE is built with: Swift, Go and SQLite.
about.thanksTesters: To everyone who tests MinorIDE: please report bugs and ideas as

app.notTextFileInfo: MinorIDE edits text files only. You can view its bytes or preview it in the Finder with Quick Look.

recoveredFiles.one: MinorIDE recovered unsaved changes in {count} file.
recoveredFiles.other: MinorIDE recovered unsaved changes in {count} files.

app.recoveredInfo: MinorIDE quit unexpectedly. The recovered text isn’t saved yet: save the files to keep it, or close them without saving.

clone.gitNotInstalled: Git is not installed. Install the Command Line Tools with “xcode-select --install”.
clone.title: Clone Git Repository

codeActions.fileChanged: The file changed in the meantime. Try again.
codeActions.fileChangedNamed: “{name}” changed in the meantime. Try again.
codeActions.fileOperationsUnsupported: The change creates, renames or deletes files, which MinorIDE does not do yet.
codeActions.remoteFileUnsupported: The change edits a file that is not on this Mac.

database.chooseTunnelKey: Choose the private key for the SSH tunnel.
database.productionHint: Shown in red and opened read-only by default.

findInFiles.prompt: Type to search the project. Files ignored by Git are skipped.
findInFiles.title: Find in Project

gitGutter.revertHint: Put back the lines from the last commit

hex.truncated: Showing the first 1 MB of {size, bytes}.

languageServers.installGoplsInfo: Go code intelligence needs gopls. MinorIDE runs “go install golang.org/x/tools/gopls@latest”, which downloads it from the Go module proxy into your Go bin folder.
languageServers.notInstalled: Not installed. Install it with go install.
languageServers.notInstalledNoGo: Not installed. Install Go first, then gopls.
languageServers.startsWithGoFile: Starts when you open a Go file
languageServers.stoppedAfterCrashes: Stopped after repeated crashes. Click Restart to try again.

localHistory.empty: No saved versions yet. A copy of the file is kept each time you save it, for 14 days.

panel.databasesEmpty: Connections to MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL and SQLite databases will appear here.
panel.languageServersEmpty: The state and log of gopls will appear here.
panel.problemsEmpty: Errors and warnings from the language server will appear here.
panel.searchEmpty: Results of Find in Project will appear here.
panel.serversEmpty: Files on servers connected over SFTP or FTPS will appear here.
panel.terminalEmpty: A terminal in the project folder will appear here.
panel.usagesEmpty: Usages of a symbol found with Navigate › Find Usages will appear here.

refactor.changesInfo: Open files change in their editors and can be undone there. Other files are saved right away; their previous versions stay in Local History.
refactor.someFilesFailed: Some files could not be changed.

savedList.deleteDatabaseInfo: The connection and its password in the Keychain will be deleted. The database itself is not changed.
savedList.deleteServerInfo: The server and its password in the Keychain will be deleted. Files on the server are not changed.
savedList.trustToSave: Trust the project to save settings in it.

server.chooseKey: Choose the private key for the server.
server.productionHint: Shown in red; uploads ask for confirmation.

settings.allLanguagesInfo: Applies to every language unless the language sets its own value.
settings.automaticFontInfo: Automatic uses Menlo when a display without Retina is connected, because it keeps accents and other thin strokes sharp, and the system monospaced font otherwise.
settings.autosaveInfo: Edited files are saved when you switch to another tab, window or app. Files changed on disk meanwhile are not saved. Every save is kept in Local History.
settings.codingStandardInfo: Default follows the language’s standard, such as PSR-12 for PHP and gofmt for Go. A file’s own line endings, .editorconfig and project settings take precedence.
settings.detectIndentationInfo: An existing file keeps the indentation it uses, unless .editorconfig or project settings say otherwise.
settings.invalidSettingsFile: settings.json is not valid JSON. Fix it in the editor; until then these settings can’t be changed here.
settings.languageOverrideInfo: Overrides All Languages for this language.
settings.pinEnclosingLinesInfo: While you scroll, the lines that open the class, function and blocks around the top of the editor stay pinned above the text. Click one to go to it.
settings.settingsFileInfo: Settings are stored in settings.json. A project can override them in .minoride/settings.json.
settings.wrapLinesInfo: Long lines continue on the next row at the line length from Format (120 when not set). Large and minified files are not wrapped.

sidebar.fileNotCreated: The file could not be created.
sidebar.invalidFileName: “{name}” is not a valid file name.

statusBar.largeFileReadOnly: Files larger than 256 MB open read-only.
statusBar.restrictedModeHint: MinorIDE doesn’t run Git, tools or commands from this project. Click to trust it.

terminal.restrictedModeInfo: In Restricted Mode the terminal doesn’t start by itself, because the shell prompt may run Git in the project folder.
terminal.startShellHint: Start a new shell in the project folder.

tools.installCommandLineTools: Install the Command Line Tools: xcode-select --install
tools.installGo: Install Go from go.dev or with Homebrew: brew install go
tools.optionalForPHP: Optional: PHP code intelligence in MinorIDE works without it.
tools.pathFallback: Your shell’s PATH could not be read, so MinorIDE looks in /opt/homebrew/bin, /usr/local/bin and ~/go/bin too.
tools.pathInfo: Tools are found with the PATH of your login shell. A missing tool only turns off what needs it.

usages.emptyHint: Usages of a symbol appear here. Use Navigate › Find Usages in an editor.
usages.noAnswer: The language server did not answer.
usages.title: Usages of “{name}”: {summary}

window.changesLostIfNotSaved: Your changes will be lost if you don’t save them.
window.fileDeleted: The file was deleted from disk. Saving creates it again.
window.replaceUnsavedQuestion: “{name}” is open with unsaved changes. Do you want to replace it?
window.restrictedModeBanner: Restricted Mode: MinorIDE doesn’t run Git, tools or commands from this project.
window.saveChangesQuestion: Do you want to save the changes made to the document “{name}”?
window.trustInfo: A trusted project can run code when MinorIDE uses Git, language servers, tools, run configurations or the debugger on it. Trust only projects from authors you trust.
window.unsavedChangesLost: Its unsaved changes will be lost.
window.unsupportedCharacters: “{name}” contains characters that {encoding} can’t store, such as “{character}”.
window.unsupportedCharactersInfo: Saving in {encoding} would replace them with question marks. You can save the file in UTF-8 instead, or remove those characters.
